dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would anyone dare to fight you?

dialogues.speaker: Venier
dialogues.text: Ah, my friend! Where did you learn to judge a book by its cover so?

dialogues.speaker: Venier
dialogues.text: I am a musician, you see! These arms are most elegant when they pluck a lyre's strings, I assure you.

dialogues.speaker: Venier
dialogues.text: Although I do not know why, though I was exhausted after waking up from a lengthy dream, my arms now feel like they have been granted manifold strength.

dialogues.speaker: Venier
dialogues.text: I've never been this tired, not even when I would play the lyre without rest or sleep.

dialogues.speaker: Venier
dialogues.text: It seems that I shall have to return to Capitolium to get some rest...
